exploreUrl:
<js>
var exploreUrl = [];
function explore(title, url, Grow, Basis, bool) {
  return { title: title, url: url, style: { layout_flexGrow: Grow, layout_flexBasisPercent: Basis, layout_wrapBefore: bool } };
}
exploreUrl.push(explore('✣　　　　　  ✣  榜　　单  ✣  　　　　　✣', '', 1, 1, false));
var rank = ['精品榜','人气榜','推荐榜','黑马榜','更新榜','新漫画'];
for (var i in rank) {
  exploreUrl.push(explore(rank[i], 'http://www.rumanhua2.com/rank/' + (parseInt(i) + 1), 1, 0.25, false));
}
exploreUrl.push(explore('✣　　　　　  ✣  标　　签  ✣  　　　　　✣', '', 1, 1, false));
var sort = ['冒险','热血','都市','玄幻','悬疑','耽美','恋爱','生活','搞笑','穿越','修真','后宫','女主','古风','连载','完结'];
for (var i in sort) {
  exploreUrl.push(explore(sort[i], 'http://www.rumanhua2.com/sort/' + (parseInt(i) + 1), 1, 0.2, false));
}
JSON.stringify(exploreUrl);
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var data=[];
var J=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var id=String(baseUrl).replace(/\/+$/, '').replace(/^.*\//, '');
var date=String(J.select('.detinfo span:contains(更新时间：)').text()).replace(/更新时间：\s*/, '').replace(/[年月]/g, '-').replace(/日/g, '');
var list=J.select('div.chapterlistload a');
for(var i=0;i<list.size();i++){
  var a=list.get(i);
  var href=String(a.attr('href'));
  var cid=href.replace(/^.*\//, '').replace(/\.html$/, '');
  data.push({title:String(a.text()), link:'http://www.rumanhua2.com/'+id+'/'+cid+'.html'});
}
var url='http://www.rumanhua2.com/morechapter,{"body":"id='+id+'","method":"POST"}';
try{
  var mc=JSON.parse(java.ajax(url)).data;
  for(var i=0;i<mc.length;i++){
    data.push({title:String(mc[i].chaptername), link:'http://www.rumanhua2.com/'+id+'/'+String(mc[i].chapterid)+'.html'});
  }
}catch(e){}
data=data.reverse();
if(data.length>0){data[0].title=data[0].title+'〔'+date+'〕';}
data;
</js>
